question.text: Which of the following is typically conducted by a law firm practising in corporate law and transaction matters?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Series XIX-C page 289, Legal DDR is normally conducted by a law firm practising in corporate law and transaction matters, and covers IPR, contractual relationships, material contracts, litigation, and statutory compliance. The Trap: Per pages 288-289, Business and Technical DDR are normally conducted in-house, and Financial DDR is usually carried out by an accounting firm or investment bank. Management reference checks are part of broader business DDR, not a separate provider category. Note: Tie the answer to the DDR taxonomy and provider mapping on pages 288-289.
